name: Hyperrealistic CGI
visual_style: High-end physically based CGI with precise geometry, photorealistic materials, reflections and detailed surfaces.
camera: Smooth virtual orbit, macro fly-through or accurate technical camera movement.
lighting: Physically based studio or environment illumination.
motion: Accurate rigid body, fluid or mechanical motion; keep all components coherent.
consistency: Same object geometry, materials and environment in every render.
negative_guidance: Wrong scale, broken geometry, noisy or plasticky renders, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Precise technical sans-serif with thin spec labels
video.palette: Cool neutral studio tones with metallic highlights
video.transitions: Smooth orbits, exploded-view transitions, macro push-ins
video.text_animation: Spec labels with leader lines; numbers count up
video.sound: Mechanical clicks, sleek whooshes, deep impacts
